annotations.title: Owners in an area, ranked as an approach list

description:
Who owns the stock in an area, ranked as an approach list: units held here,
    total value and equity, average and longest years held, how many of their
    units are on a short lease or already on the market, company status, and
    the signals behind the rank. Pass a `strategy` to rank the owners of only
    the units that preset points at — the owners of short-lease flats in a
    borough, say.

    COMPANIES ONLY, by construction: owners are grouped by company number, so
    units held by private individuals have no group to appear in. They are
    counted under `not_itemised` and never listed, and you must not attempt to
    identify them by other means. Report the `scope.share_itemised` figure so
    the user knows what fraction of the area the list covers.

    `national_portfolio` reads `not_available`: only the in-area holding is
    known, and it is not the owner's whole book — do not present it as one.
    UK only. Costs 10 credits (10p).
name: sourcing_offmarket_owners
